label: V2 (VANOSRT3)
verification: V2 retains the byte-identical V1 runtime logic proven on-car, uses a distinct VANOSRT3 marker, and recomputes the enforced MS41.0 program checksum. Exact V1 upgrade, V1 removal, isolated V2 composition, checksums, and definition matching are regression-tested.
title: VANOS minimum RPM
user_description: Legacy MS41.0 V2. Original VANOS logic can command engagement at 8,160 RPM. Upgrade to V3 to keep the factory decision.
description: VANOSRT3 is retained for exact detection, upgrade and removal. V2 recomputes the program checksum and compares every setting, including the reserved 0xFF default, against the RPM mirror. VANOSRPM is at SA 0x3000 and the marker at SA 0x3008.
